stem.text: A girl is jumping on a trampoline.
Which graph shows the variation of the girl’s velocity $v$ with time $t$?

A.alt: Velocity against time: starts at a positive value, falls straight to a negative minimum, rises straight to a positive peak, and repeats as a triangular wave

B.alt: Velocity against time: smooth sinusoidal curve starting at a positive value

C.alt: Velocity against time: smooth curve starting at a positive value, with straight-line segments between the peaks and troughs

D.alt: Velocity against time: straight falling segments with sharp vertical rises, a sawtooth-like pattern
